tools.name: get-install-command
tools.description: Return the SDK install command for Moss in the requested language. Use when the user asks how to install or add Moss to their project.

tools.name: get-pricing
tools.description: Return the current Moss subscription tiers with monthly price and included features. Use when the user asks how much Moss costs or which tier they need.

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Navigate the current tab to a named section of moss.dev. Use this to take the user to pricing, the blog, or to external docs.

section.description: home = /, pricing = /pricing, blog = /blog, docs = https://docs.moss.dev, portal = https://portal.usemoss.dev
